title: Student Atlas
description:
A personalized map of opportunities for high school students, especially ones without easy access to a college counselor. It started as my entry for the TSA Webmaster 2026 competition. It covers 200+ curated research programs, internships, competitions, summer programs and scholarships across seven areas.
A short Pathway Wizard builds a private profile and every opportunity gets an explainable fit score. Zeus, the built-in guide, understands plain-English questions, searches the directory and helps students plan. College Lab adds essay feedback, transcript and GPA analysis, a mentor chat and a college list, and teachers can run class rooms with a dashboard.
howItWorks:
Zeus runs entirely in the browser with no AI service: it pulls intent out of the question (interest, grade, cost, format, deadlines, state), ranks opportunities with BM25 keyword search plus the student's match scores, tolerates typos and remembers the conversation.
College Lab can use Claude for richer feedback when the site has an API key, and falls back to built-in analysis when it doesn't. The site is static and deploys on Vercel.
